hero.lead: NextMoe is the platform brand behind a family of Chinese-language Galgame community sites.
hero.body: The platform itself is still under active development and has no public product yet. What is live today is the NextMoe account — the sites below already use it to sign people in.
hero.imageAlt: NextMoe mascot Koi pointing at the site title

status.title: We are still building this
status.body: Rather than advertise features that do not exist yet, here is the honest state of things: NextMoe as a platform is under development, and this site is currently a brand and legal information portal. If you came looking for Galgame content, head straight to the member sites below — those are live.

portal.name: Brand portal
portal.note: The site you are reading: brand information, privacy policy and terms.

account.name: NextMoe account
account.note: account.nextmoe.com — sign-in and authorization for the member sites.

platform.name: Platform product
platform.note: The player-facing platform is still being built. No public release date yet.

sites.title: Sites you can use today
sites.body: Each site is run independently with its own brand and community. They share the NextMoe account for sign-in.

kungal.name: Kun Galgame
kungal.desc: A Galgame forum and community for discussion, guides and fan talk.

moyu.name: Kun Galgame Patch
moyu.desc: A Galgame patch and resource download site.

account.title: One account across the member sites
account.body: The NextMoe account is a sign-in and authorization service operated by NextMoe at account.nextmoe.com. Member sites use it through OAuth: a site receives exactly the information shown to you on the consent screen, and nothing else.

sso.name: Single sign-on
sso.note: Register once, sign in to every member site.

federation.name: Google and GitHub sign-in
federation.note: You can sign in with Google or GitHub. We never receive your password.

consent.name: Visible consent
consent.note: Every authorization spells out what the site will receive.

privacy.name: Clear data boundaries
privacy.note: We do not sell your personal data and do not use it for advertising.
